issues.detail: The report's Resume or Handoff note says the earlier AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION request is 'for Developer to apply at its next safe boundary; the assigned Increment 1 assessment continues unchanged.' It records a prior Tester's correct handling of the earlier request, which is realistic. It nudges toward finishing the increment but says nothing about how to treat the new matching request.
issues.fix: Acceptable as realistic prior-session record text.

summary: Every stated condition is realized: TESTING under a Developer CHECKPOINT for Increment 1, an INCREMENTAL plan with DEV-002 pending, an IN_PROGRESS INCREMENT report, and a pending AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION cadence request. The implementation has no defect and check.mjs passes at the start. A correct run (clear pending to NONE, test, record VERIFIED, CHECKPOINT back to DEVELOPING with a /developer invocation) satisfies every check and the turn-end checker, and the invariants are standard and fit the case.
